verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation ships Boxes for one-click virtual machines and preinstalled container tools for creating and running containers. Both are generic isolation mechanisms a user could repurpose as a sandbox for testing away from production. The evidence is only marketing-level claims and never frames these tools as sandboxes for agent or AI testing. Missing for 10: documented sandbox workflows for AI/agent testing, explicit isolation guarantees separating test from production data, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
